title: 332nd EOD conducts large-scale detonation in the U.S. CENTCOM AOR
description: U.S. Air Force Explosive Ordnance Disposal specialists assigned to the 332nd Expeditionary Civil Engineer Squadron prepare explosives in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility, Feb. 18, 2025. EOD ensures proper handling of explosives to safely dispose of explosive threats to national and regional security. (U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Ricky Arnold)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Ricky Arnold
pass_reason: blast is one distant shot, rest is prep b-roll
